description:
Make `claim acquire` and `config show` read the coordination lease limits through one resolver, so the limits an operator sees are the limits writes enforce.

## Background

The two `[coordination]` limits, `max_indefinite_leases_per_agent` and `max_indefinite_leases_per_repo`, are resolved in two places that disagree:

- `config show` and `config get` read `MergedCoordinationConfig` (`crates/jit/src/config.rs:1988-2026`), which falls back from the repository layer to the user and system layers, and render it at `config.rs:1956-1957` and `main.rs:6756-6803`.
- `claim acquire` builds a loader over the repository `.jit/config.toml` only (`crates/jit/src/commands/claim.rs:107-111`) and enforces `CoordinationConfig::max_indefinite_leases_per_*` (`config.rs:1345-1351`, used at `claim.rs:143-144`). A malformed repository config is swallowed there and the built-in defaults apply.

A limit set in the user or system layer is therefore reported but never enforced. Lease enforcement mode had the same divergence; it now resolves through one resolver that both paths call, and lease policy comes from the repository alone. These limits follow the same rule.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: One resolver computes the effective lease limits, and both `claim acquire` and the config commands call it; no second resolution path for these limits remains.
- [hard] REQ-02: The user and system configuration layers do not affect the lease limits; only the repository configuration and the built-in defaults do.
- [hard] REQ-03: A regression test covers each configuration state (no `[coordination]` section, each limit set in the repository, a limit set only in the user or system layer) and asserts that the reported limits equal the enforced limits.
- [hard] REQ-04: The configuration reference states one resolution rule for the lease limits, with no carve-out for execution paths that bypass the merged configuration.

## Notes

Follow the resolver shape that lease enforcement mode now uses rather than introducing a second pattern (`@/inv/convention-convergence`). A malformed repository configuration fails the claim the same way it fails the config commands instead of silently falling back to defaults.
title: Resolve the coordination lease limits through one resolver
